explanation: Layer-0, context-free token-identity detector: N265+ fires on a fixed, graded set of token ids and its strength is set by the token at that position alone (the same token gives the identical value in every context and even in a one-token prompt, e.g. ' друг' = 1.344 and 'Defendant' = 1.283, and the scan's input attribution puts 100% of every peak on the peak token itself with 0% on the token before). The set is arbitrary in meaning but not uniform in strength: its top band (>= 0.62 x the 1.61 vocabulary maximum, 1.34 scan maximum) is court-caption party nouns ('Defendants' 1.61, 'Plaintiff' 1.38, 'Appellees' 1.29, 'Defendant' 1.28, 'appellants' 1.15, 'Appellants' 1.10, 'Petitioners' 1.04) and PLOS/PMC journal codes and journal names ('pntd' 1.60, 'pbio' 1.54, 'pcbi' 1.44, 'ppat' 1.41, 'pmed' 1.40, 'pone' 1.33, 'pgen' 1.32, 'ijerph' 1.28, 'micromachines' 1.24, 'eLife' 1.20), a second band (0.55-1.10) holds biomedical Latin stems ('dopaminergic' 0.92, 'aeruginosa' 0.88, 'periodontal' 0.65, 'prefrontal' 0.63, 'hypoxia' 0.63, 'methylation' 0.62), software/library proper nouns ('javax' 1.01, 'BOOST' 0.95, 'android' 0.92, 'GOOGLE' 0.91, 'ubuntu' 0.91, 'python' 1.06), LaTeX commands ('textstyle' 0.99, 'nolimits' 0.70, 'ensuremath' 0.66), non-English word-initial fragments ('од' 1.21, 'ש' 1.16, 'hä' 1.11, 'uno' 1.08, 'ส' 0.98) and a small indefinite/quantifier cluster ('attention' 1.09, 'WARRANTY' 1.08, 'one' 1.02, bare 'Another' 1.20 against ' Another' 0.79, ' Everyone' 0.81, ' others' 0.73 - 'one'/'another' are what its co-activating partners N15+/N1331+/N1616+ also fire on), while every function word (the/of/and/a/in/is/that), every ordinary English noun tested (house, water, book, woman, morning, summer, table, government, river, wedding, toddler, stroke, field) and all digits, punctuation and whitespace tokens sit at 0.000. The exact token id outranks the word: bare 'molecules' 1.45 vs ' molecules' 0.39, 'Defendants' 1.61 vs ' defendants' 0.83, so a leading space or a capital changes the prediction more than the meaning, and the set follows neither token frequency (Spearman +0.10 against corpus count) nor embedding norm (r = 0.00).
